Save ladder route (ladders\Expedition33.json): the harness copies the rung's save over slot 0 (EXPEDITION_0.sav, save_slot below), stamped with the current time so Steam Cloud keeps it. Route: warning > title > 계속하기 (Continue: always opens the 게임 불러오기 load list; it does not jump to PlatformSaveData's LatestSaveGameLoaded) > the cursor starts on the first card = slot 0 > F > 확인 > fixed load wait (no loading-screen checkpoint yet) > play (W/A/S/D, mouse camera; never F = interact, M map, Tab/I menus) > Esc > pause menu > 6 x down to 종료 > 확인 (데스크톱으로 돌아가시겠습니까?). The cards come from SavesContainer.sav, not from the .sav: slot 0's card keeps showing the previous save (place, date, playtime) until the game autosaves; loading reads EXPEDITION_0.sav. slot1_card_second checks that slot 1's card (the user's 1-minute prologue save: 뤼미에르, 2026. 2. 6. 오후 4:10:49) is the second entry, i.e. slot 0 is still first: if the list turns out to sort by date (oldest first) a run that autosaves slot 0 would move it below slot 1, and this check fails the run instead of loading the wrong save. NEVER press R in the load list (deletes the save) or X there (previous saves list). In the pause menu 이전 저장 데이터 불러오기 / 메뉴로 돌아가기 are 5th / 6th: 종료 is 7th (the menu has 7 items at the camp; check that the prologue has the same 7). Combat is turn based: walking into an enemy starts a battle where these keys do nothing and Esc opens a different menu (MENU_FAIL, no harm).
